org.apache.rat.config.exclusion

Class ExclusionProcessor

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.apache.rat.config.exclusion.ExclusionProcessor

  • public class ExclusionProcessor
extends Object
    Processes the include and exclude patterns and applies the result against a base directory to return an IReportable that contains all the reportable objects.
